section.20: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day

20.name_native: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Shaqiq said:"We were commanded, when we got up to pray at night, to clean our mouths with the siwak
